query:
DELETE FROM kernel.events
                 WHERE id IN (
                     SELECT e.id FROM kernel.events e
                      WHERE e.occurred_at < now() - make_interval(days => $1)
                        AND NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM kernel.jobs j
                             WHERE j.event_id = e.id AND j.state IN ('pending', 'running'))
                      LIMIT $2)
